title: Safe Product
statement: Implement `solve(nums)`. Return the product of the integers. An empty list returns 1, the identity for multiplication.
hints: A loop starting at 1 matches it.
Do not return 0 for an empty list.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The product of no factors is 1, just as the sum of no terms is 0.

editorial: The product of no factors is 1, just as the sum of no terms is 0. Starting the accumulator at 1 makes the empty list work without a special case. A zero in the list still forces the product to 0.
